overview: The Word Bearers’ devotion is challenged by the Emperor, sending their primarch and his sons in search of an answer.
synopsis: The Emperor condemns the Word Bearers’ worship and orders the destruction of Monarchia. Lorgar seeks another account of the universe, while Argel Tal and his company become part of an expedition into territory the Imperial Truth cannot explain.

The journey transforms Argel Tal and the warriors with him. The Word Bearers’ new convictions are developed in secret, and their eventual role at Isstvan V connects a spiritual crisis to the wider rebellion.
detailed: The Ultramarines evacuate Monarchia before its destruction. Lorgar and his Legion are forced to kneel before the Emperor and accept his rejection of their religious devotion. For the Word Bearers, the punishment undermines the purpose they believed they served.

Encouraged by Kor Phaeron and Erebus, Lorgar searches for beings that will accept the worship the Emperor refuses. Argel Tal’s company is sent on a voyage into the Eye of Terror. Ingethel guides them through revelations framed to dismantle their former beliefs.

The expedition returns with its warriors altered by daemonic possession. Argel Tal becomes the commander of the Gal Vorbak, living with an internal presence named Raum. His relationship with the human survivor Cyrene Valantion anchors a part of his humanity amid the change.

The Legion conceals its new allegiance while working within the structures of the Great Crusade. At Isstvan V, that deception becomes open betrayal. Argel Tal participates in the massacre of the loyalist Legions, completing the movement from wounded faith to deliberate rebellion.
